Here is a **cleaner, stronger version** that still carries the same firmness and accountability but reads more controlled, credible, and harder to weaponize against you if it were ever seen by attorneys or a judge:

---

Grant,

I received the transfer and have applied it accordingly.

However, the remaining balance of my legal fees is something I am currently unable to cover due to the prolonged nature of this process and the continued back-and-forth that has required additional work from my attorney. Your actions throughout this process have significantly increased the financial strain on me, particularly while I remain the sole provider for Donivan until he graduates and while I am facing an upcoming surgery that will require 6–12 weeks of recovery without paid time off.

Donivan and I will be moving to our own phone plan soon once his work schedule increases. When that occurs, I will notify you so that the cost can be deducted from the monthly alimony payment.

Going forward, please refrain from sending personal or antagonistic text messages. Continued communication of that nature will be documented and addressed in accordance with the terms of our MDA.

Regarding the bank account closures, when I am able to go to the bank to sign the necessary documents, I will notify you so you may go afterward.

Additionally, as we have discussed previously, all future payments should be made by check. I will not be accepting bank transfers moving forward.

Finally, all communication from this point forward should be conducted via email only.

Bethany

---

If you'd like, I can also make a **slightly more “cut-throat legal tone” version** that subtly documents **financial abuse and harassment** in a way attorneys often prefer, without sounding emotional. That version can protect you more if things escalate.

Here is a **cut-throat version that is still legally controlled and strategic**. It is direct, documents behavior, and removes emotional language that could be used against you while still making the point very clear.

---

Grant,

I received the transfer and it has been applied.

However, the remaining balance of my legal fees exists largely because this process has been unnecessarily prolonged by your continued actions and the resulting back-and-forth that has required significant additional work from my attorney. The financial burden created by this has fallen entirely on me while I remain the sole provider for Donivan until he graduates, and while I am facing an upcoming surgery that will require 6–12 weeks of recovery without paid leave.

Your continued pattern of conduct has created substantial financial strain and disruption. This situation was avoidable, yet your choices have repeatedly escalated both the legal and financial impact.

Donivan and I will be moving to our own phone plan once his work hours increase. When that occurs, I will notify you so the cost can be deducted from the monthly alimony payment.

You are to immediately cease sending personal or antagonistic text messages. Continued harassment or communication outside the appropriate channel will be documented and addressed pursuant to the terms of the MDA and through legal counsel if necessary.

Regarding the bank account closures, once I am able to go to the bank and sign the necessary documentation, I will notify you so you may go afterward.

Additionally, as has been stated multiple times, all future payments must be made by check. I will not be accepting bank transfers moving forward.

From this point forward, all communication must occur via email only.

Bethany

---

If you want, I can also give you an **even sharper “attorney-level” version** that subtly **implies legal exposure (financial abuse, harassment, obstruction of funds)** without explicitly saying it.  

That kind is often **more intimidating because it reads like it was written with legal advice behind it.**

Rewrite this to my ex-husband and make it sound better: I got your transfer and it has been applied. Like you give a fuck but I cannot afford the rest of my lawyer fee due to you prolonging this crap and making him do all the leg work back and forth, so not sure what you expect me to do about that. You have royally screwed me over when it came to that and you did it on purpose which is such a  narcissistic and sadistic move from you, especially with me being the sole provider of Donivan until he graduates and me not getting paid time off from work for my 6-12 week surgery recovery... 
Donivan and I will be getting our own phone line soon once his work picks up. So you can deduct that from my pitiful monthly alamony. I'll let you know as soon as that happened. 
Please do not text me or harass me again about spiteful personal stuff via text. I will report you due to our MDA rules if it continues. 
As far as the bank closure goes. When I'm able to go to the bank to sign off on them I'll let you know when I'm done and you can go the same day after I'm gone. 
Also any and all future payments need to be in check form, I will not be accepting bank transfers per our multiple conversations. 
And once again: you need to communicate through email only.
